title: How to Manage Short-Stay Operations With Your Own Brand (White Label)
summary: See how to run short-stay operations with your own brand identity, using a White Label platform.
body_markdown:
Managing short-stay operations under your own brand means the system your team and property owners interact with carries your domain, logo, and colors — not a third-party vendor's name. In **Jestor** , this is the **White Label** solution, applied across the whole platform.


Short-stay operators managing properties for external owners often need the operational platform to reinforce their own brand, not a vendor's, especially when owners are actively comparing management companies.


## What matters about brand identity for operators


- Property owners trusting a platform that reflects the operator's own established brand
- Internal tools feeling like part of the operator's own systems, not a foreign add-on
- Consistency between the operational platform and the operator's client-facing brand
- The ability to present a cohesive, professional brand to owners and partners


## How White Label operations work


- Custom domain, so the underlying platform's own domain never appears
- Logo, name, and colors apply to the login screen and the whole menu
- The side menu is fully customizable — colors, cover, and which items are visible
- This applies across the whole platform, not a single branded page


## Why Jestor fits this use case


- White Label is a full solution, not a cosmetic setting
- Owners and staff interact with an experience that reinforces the operator's brand
- The underlying operational capabilities — bookings, approvals, dashboards — stay the same
- Operators can present a more cohesive, professional platform to prospective owner clients


White Label element What it covers


Domain Custom, no vendor domain visible


Login and menu Logo, name, and colors fully customizable

## Frequently Asked Questions


**Does White Label apply to the whole platform or just one page?** It applies across the whole platform — domain, login, and menu. More at[jestor.com](https://www.jestor.com/?ref=blog.jestor.com) .


**Can property owners access a White Label view of their own data?** Yes, with scoped permissions limiting them to their own properties.


**Does White Label change the underlying operational functionality?** No, bookings, approvals, and dashboards work exactly the same underneath.
